messages.subject: Indigo - negotiation strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Ahead of Wednesday's call: hold firm on Caspian owning all core-platform improvements - non-negotiable per Henry. We can give ground on exclusivity (6 years) and a modest cut to the minimum royalty (£1.05m). On liability, 125% of fees is acceptable; keep the IP indemnity sensible (£13.5m). Elena, please prep a short issues list for the client.

Sarah
